page.overview:
Who is Malvegil?

Malvegil was the sixth King of Arthedain.

Malvegil was the son of King Celebrindor of Arthedain and came to the throne in TA 1272 at the death of his father. Under his rule the enemy realm of Angmar was established by the Witch-king north of the Ettenmoors in the Mountains of Angmar, and evil things began to appear in Eriador. Many Orcs and evil Men began to gather on both sides of the Misty Mountains, and Arthedain was in an uneasy watch ever after. Malvegil died in TA 1349 at the age of two-hundred and five after ruling for seventy-seven years and was succeeded by his son Argeleb I.

The name Malvegil means "Golden sword" from the Sindarin words mal ("gold") and megil or later vegil ("sword").
